text.content:
The faces of Greenrest — one line each. GM-only quick reference; names link to their sheets.

  • @UUID[Actor.fYMlXAs6ZT8aMC6R]{Mayor Oswin Applewhite} — the patron; warm, fatherly, and fully willing to let the party die for the town. Seat: the Mayor's Tower.
  • @UUID[Actor.krdThcl2lpElRTny]{Selma} — the apothecary; the town's only healing and the secret dream-suppressing tonic. A quiet wildcard.
  • @UUID[Actor.KaqoEWW6smO4j4a7]{Ambrose Featherstone} — innkeeper of The Long Rest; a grandfatherly host, kindest to the strangers who'll never wake.
  • @UUID[Actor.JBEHNnZOEsNrtDmV]{Mother Wend} — elderly dwarf; keeps The Full Larder; quietly "runs short" around shard 3.
  • @UUID[Actor.ngCd4uR5R5m8NJYZ]{Acolyte Enid} — the church's devout young lay-keeper; the purest believer in the false faith; tends the graves.
  • @UUID[Actor.kR6ypkx4lCH5TY3P]{Constable Warin Holt} — the town watch; musters the militia against the party at the finale.
  • @UUID[Actor.yQxQmPxsIMzupeDv]{Coll} — the gravedigger and town doubter; has buried too many smiling strangers to keep believing.
  • @UUID[Actor.6qPZywHoNoJP4ZLt]{Pip} — a young halfling child; asks the questions no adult will.
  • Brother Tobin — a wandering Chauntean priest (not a resident; met on the road).
